definition-changed.answer: The rule uses 'procedure division' (the division), never the defined term 'procedure'; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division' vs §2023:3.145 does not touch what the division is. Scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.12.1.1 through §2002:14.5.12.2 against §2023:14.6.13.1.1 through §2023:14.6.13.2. The 2002 differences are: no MERGE/SORT, fatal-EC-I-O or PERFORM WHEN steps in fatal processing (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 (items 2-4) are 2023-only), the 2002 non-fatal wording, and the incompatible-data text. GR1 only says where execution begins (the first statement, excluding declaratives) and that statements run in written order 'except where the rules indicate some other order'; entry into a declarative is §2002:14.5.3 (item 3)'s implicit transfer, not this rule. It does not rest on how an exception is processed; the twins run at 2002 have no exception at all.
